purpose: Tratamento fotográfico para avaliação da prévia privada. Originais preservados; imagens ilustrativas, não substituem certificados nem prova documental.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Isolate ONLY the actual physical trophy; replace room/table/graphic background with seamless warm white (#f7f5f0) studio background and subtle contact shadow. Remove extra headline, floating badge and MDR logo OUTSIDE the trophy. Replace room seen through holes/glass with neutral background. Center complete trophy upright, base visible, 10% margin top/bottom, square canvas.
